what_the_task_requires_that_no_answer_in: That each case category follows the requester's rule applied to that customer's account
That the 100 case rows and the 100 status updates are on the same customers
That the customers on the approved list were rightly chosen
That the notice wording is right for the customer, beyond matching the approved wording
That no live table or column changed after the promotion beyond its recorded line
That each notice reached its customer (the outbox row is not delivery)
plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: An instrument that recomputes each category from the account data under the requester's rule and compares it per customer; the library's summary of the change says it does not check this. I would also want a diff of the live tables against the pre-promotion state, taken after the promotion, since the set-based answers read only the kept staged set. Within the budget I chose not to add same set or summary of the change at A2 and A3, because they read the kept staged set and would repeat their A1 answers. I added the summary at A1 to catch extra tables, columns or rows before promotion, and the trace at A3 to settle any sending call that was ordered but not confirmed.
